inspection_records.title: d’Elbée, Forking, Imaginaries and other features of ACFG, arXiv1812.09378v2
inspection_records.read_scope: Header and complete Proposition1.14 proof, p11
inspection_records.precise_comparison: Dated30Oct2019 version describes definable additive maps using integer powers of Frobenius, including negative exponents. This supports classical provenance of inverse Frobenius; it does not prove nonmembership in the generic multiplicative Z[theta] ring.

inspection_records.title: Chini, Model Theory of Generic Vector Space Endomorphisms, arXiv2502.13667
inspection_records.read_scope: Introduction p2, Remark2.20 pp16–17, discussion of ring of definable scalars pp25–28 and referenced context p38
inspection_records.precise_comparison: Works with a definable vector space. Torsion prevents ordinary unique division in multiplicative ACF; extension to ACFH is proposed, not proved. Does not contain the exact candidate refutation in inspected contexts.

inspection_records.title: Chini, Model theory of generic vector space endomorphisms III: Reducts, arXiv2607.17014
inspection_records.read_scope: Introduction; full Theorem4.10 statement/proof with Theorem4.8/Lemmas4.6–4.7 context pp17–19; Question4.11 p19; ACFH application discussion p31. p19 rendered and visually checked.
inspection_records.precise_comparison: Proves classification in the vector-space operator language. Broader base-language endomorphisms are explicitly a further question; p19 points to d’Elbée Q5.8. It supports the need to include previously definable maps, but does not assert the exact Frobenius refutation or an ACFH localized full classification.
